implementation_status: Design only except separately verified room date/dialogue continuity.

decisions.decision: Harem-lit alternate 1870s Weird West with steam robotics/mechas, ordinary accepted spirits and ambiguous occult gods battling on Earth.
decisions.consequence: Supersedes a purely historical cattle-drive identity.

decisions.decision: All romance women are adults 18 or older, mostly 18–24; older adults allowed. Slim, small-busted adult silhouettes and provocative PG-13 clothing.
decisions.consequence: Explicit age in all authored/generated romance records; no child-coded design. Earlier proposed 21+ minimum is superseded.

decisions.decision: Eligible women are recruitable harem companions, including named and procedural characters with individual perks.
decisions.consequence: Model stable identity, recruitment and perks independently of relationship stage.

decisions.decision: Everyone has madness; intimacy with loved ones reduces it.
decisions.consequence: Shared madness contract covers player, companions, rustlers and other NPCs.

decisions.decision: Voluntary adult relationships; PG-13 affection and fade-to-black intimacy; shared rest and support count as intimacy.
decisions.consequence: No mandatory sexual transaction for recruitment or recovery.
Replace the prior 1868 HUD date; this is an alternate-history starting-date choice.

decisions.decision: Eleanor is age 24 and a frontier healer familiar with spirits.
decisions.consequence: Preserve existing room sprite; do not claim new outfit approval.

decisions.decision: Prove the current single room before broadening scope; repair lasso and animation sequence quality.
decisions.consequence: Future relationship, madness and supernatural systems remain design only until the room visual bar is met.

decisions.decision: Madness 0–100, four bands, sample perks, recovery amount/time/caps and relationship stage names.
decisions.consequence: Untested values require a bounded implementation and playtest.

decisions.decision: Roster limits, death/departure persistence policy, world scale, machine economy, mecha control and procedural population weights.
decisions.consequence: Do not silently implement assumptions as accepted design.

decisions.decision: Ordinary but gorgeous adult women who are slim, small-chested, healthy, active, charming and self-confident; self-chosen rebellious PG-13 clothing is secondary to personality.
decisions.consequence: Supersedes a cast organized around revealing fantasy outfits alone.

decisions.decision: Most romance develops through gameplay, playing as companions and short unique RPG adventures, with mutual attraction and short lively dialogue.
decisions.consequence: Avoid endless conversation trees, begging and constant refusal/persuasion loops; each companion gets a distinct playable adventure beat.

decisions.decision: Switch control for a bounded authored adventure while preserving actor identity and state, then return safely with rewards applied once.
decisions.consequence: No current actor-switch implementation; preserve the current animation-repair milestone.
